references.text: Describes the cities of refuge to be given to the Levites, including cities for those who killed someone accidentally
Ramoth in Gilead is mentioned as a city of refuge east of the Jordan for the tribe of Gad
Ramoth in Gilead is designated as one of the cities of refuge east of the Jordan
Mahanaim is mentioned as a place where Jacob met God's angels
Ramoth-Gilead is mentioned as one of Solomon's administrative districts
Ramoth in Gilead was the city that King Ahab sought to recover from the Arameans
Mahanaim was the place where Ish-bosheth was made king over Israel by Abner
David fled to Mahanaim during Absalom's rebellion
Parallel text describing the Levitical cities given from the tribe of Gad
